# GPT-5.6 Luna

## Pricing

| Input | Cached input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $0.20 | $0.02 | $1.20 |

Prompts with >272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full request.
Cache writes are billed at 1.25x the uncached input token rate.
